summary: Baichuan AI's official pricing page states that users newly registered from the afternoon of 22 May 2024 receive ¥80 in free credit (raised from ¥8), equivalent to 10 million Baichuan 2-Turbo tokens, valid for 3 months and effective upon account registration. Baichuan2-Turbo (32k context) is priced at ¥0.008 per 1,000 tokens for input and output.
claim_steps: Register a new account on the Baichuan AI platform (platform.baichuan-ai.com)
The ¥80 free credit takes effect on registration and is valid for 3 months
